business_scope.primary_industry_name: Design and Commissioning of Reverse Osmosis Water Treatment Works

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid civil law jurisdiction codified principally by Egyptian Civil Code, Commercial Code, and Companies Law, with Islamic Sharia as a primary source of legislation under Article 2 of the Constitution and a separate administrative court track for regulatory disputes
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Egypt-UAE Agreement on the Promotion and Protection of Investments (active)
Egypt-Germany Bilateral Investment Treaty (entered into force 2001)
Network of over 110 bilateral investment treaties and 50 double tax avoidance agreements administered by the Egyptian Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Ministry of Finance

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law No. 80 of 2002 on Combating Money Laundering, as amended; Executive Regulations of the Anti-Money Laundering Law issued by Prime Ministerial Decree No. 95 of 2003; Companies Law No. 159 of 1981, as amended, together with its Executive Regulations; Prime Ministerial Decree No. 1378 of 2020 issuing the Beneficial Owner Register Regulations; Central Bank of Egypt Law No. 88 of 2003 and CBE KYC/AML circulars; Financial Regulatory Authority decisions applicable to regulated non-bank activities
ubo_and_aml_profiling.ubo_disclosure_level: Government_Only_Access — UBO declarations must be disclosed to the General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI), the Egyptian Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing Combating Unit (EMLCU), and the Central Bank of Egypt upon request; the beneficial ownership data is not made available through the publicly searchable commercial registry

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of the certificate of incorporation, certificate of good standing, and constitutional documents of each foreign corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent company registry or official trade register in the corporate shareholder's country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization — Egypt has not acceded to the 1961 Hague Apostille Convention; the document must be certified by the country-of-origin competent authority and legalized by the Embassy/Consulate of the Arab Republic of Egypt, then translated into Arabic by an accredited translator

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized passport copies and legal identity documents for each shareholder, manager, and ultimate beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport office / national civil registry authority in the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization — original notarization in the issuing state, followed by Egyptian Embassy/Consulate legalization and accredited Arabic translation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Power of Attorney appointing the local incorporation agent, registered office holder, and signatories for GAFI filings
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public or corporate secretary in the country of origin of the appointing party
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization — notarized in the country of origin, then authenticated by the Egyptian Consulate; Arabic translation must accompany the document

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Board resolution of each foreign corporate shareholder authorizing establishment of the Egyptian limited liability company, designation of managers, and approval of the draft articles of association
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Board of directors of the foreign corporate shareholder and company secretary
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization — board resolution must be notarized, legalized by the Egyptian Consulate, and translated into Arabic

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter and source-of-funds certificate for each shareholder and ultimate beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Originating bank or licensed financial institution
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization — original or certified copy notarized at the issuing bank, legalized by the Egyptian Consulate, and submitted with an Arabic certified translation

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all shareholders, managers, UBOs, and authorized signatories against the United Nations Security Council consolidated lists, OFAC SDN list, EU consolidated sanctions, UK HMT sanctions, and the Egyptian terrorist entities list under Law No. 80 of 2002 and Executive Regulations Decree No. 95 of 2003. Politically exposed persons, their family members, and close associates must be classified as high-risk and require enhanced due diligence, senior-management approval, and source-of-wealth verification. Any sanctions match or unusual transaction must be reported immediately to the Egyptian Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing Combating Unit (EMLCU).

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: GAFI Electronic Services Portal and Companies Registration One-Stop Shop — General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI), https://www.gafi.gov.eg
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The statutory trade name of the Egyptian LLC must be written in the Arabic alphabet and must be unique, non-misleading, and consistent with the lawful business purpose. A Latin-script transliteration may be entered as a secondary trading name, but the Arabic name is controlling for registration, contracts, and litigation. The term 'LLC' or 'Limited Liability Company' is a legal-form suffix recorded by the registrar rather than a component of the approved Arabic trade name; the reserved name must not contain abbreviations or numerals unless strictly necessary and approved as part of a distinctive mark.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: 'Misr' (Egypt), 'Arab Republic of Egypt', 'Presidential', 'Government', 'Ministry', 'Public Authority', 'Army', or 'Police' — requires ministerial or Cabinet-level prior approval and is generally unavailable to private LLCs

Any reference to 'Municipal', 'Governorate', 'City Council', 'Cairo', 'Alexandria', 'Port Said', or 'Suez Canal' in a manner implying state or municipal sponsorship — restricted for private companies and requires the written consent of the relevant governorate or competent authority

Religious tokens such as 'Islamic', 'Christian', 'Al-Azhar', 'Mosque', 'Church', or 'Qur'an' — requires prior coordination with the relevant religious authority and is normally rejected for commercial LLCs

Financial tokens such as 'Bank', 'Finance', 'Investment', 'Insurance', 'Trust', 'Exchange', 'Treasury', or 'Capital' — requires prior no-objection from the Central Bank of Egypt or the Financial Regulatory Authority

Sectoral tokens such as 'Petroleum', 'Gas', 'Electricity', 'Water', 'Sewage', 'Utilities', or 'Pipeline' — requires sector regulator consent and may be disallowed in the trade name for a private contractor unless the company holds the corresponding statutory license

Monopolistic or superlative tokens such as 'International', 'Global', 'Holding', 'Group', 'Central', or 'National' — requires evidence of minimum capitalization or group structure and prior GAFI approval
Names identical or confusingly similar to a registered company, commercial registry, or trademark in Egypt
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If GAFI rejects the proposed name, the applicant may file a written administrative appeal with GAFI's Internal Complaints Committee within 30 days from the date of the written rejection. The appeal must include the original rejection notice, the proposed Arabic and Latin names, corrected constitution documents, and a memorandum explaining statutory eligibility. GAFI is expected to issue a decision within 30 days; if the appeal is denied, the applicant may file an annulment action before the Cairo Administrative Court under Law No. 47 of 1972. As a practical protective step, the applicant may concurrently reserve alternate names before the appeal if the portal permits multiple reservations, and any unused reservation may be renewed once for an additional 30 days upon the payment of a new fee.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Virtual office is not permissible for the intended ISIC 4220 municipal sewage treatment EPC activity. Egyptian commercial registry practice and the Public Works Tender Rules require a physical, identifiable registered office in Egypt where the commercial register plate is displayed, corporate records are maintained, and authorized representatives are available during business hours. A transitional arrangement using a licensed lawyer's or corporate service provider's office may be accepted during pre-incorporation and tax-card registration, but an operational office with project engineering, water-quality records, HSE manuals, and personnel files must be established before the entity enters into the municipal or World Bank-financed contract.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Quantified risk is approximately 25% for the first operating year for a foreign-owned LLC engaged in construction and public utilities contracting, based on Egyptian Tax Authority and GAFI inspection patterns and the prevalence of document/address mismatch checks. The risk increases to near 100% at the municipal sewage treatment worksite because the contracting authority, project engineer, and World Bank supervision missions conduct regular physical verification of plant commissioning, water testing, health and safety, and staffing. Therefore, the registered-office-specific unannounced inspection risk is estimated at 10-15%, while site-based compliance inspection risk is effectively guaranteed.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff under GAFI fee schedule implementing Companies Law No. 159 of 1981

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization in Egypt and certified Arabic translation of constitutional documents, UBO declarations, and source-of-funds letters
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed Egyptian notary public and accredited Arabic translator
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Ministry of Justice notary tariff plus prevailing translation market fees (estimated US$200 notary and US$120 translation)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory stamp duties and administrative filing fees, plus US$120 fixed fee for authorized tax filing agent

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Law No. 159 of 1981 on Joint-Stock Companies, Partnerships Limited by Shares and Limited Liability Companies, as amended; Executive Regulations issued by Prime Ministerial Decree No. 3426 of 1982; Investment Law No. 72 of 2017 applicable through the General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) — One-Stop-Shop and Commercial Registry Department, Cairo, Egypt
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Notarized Memorandum of Association and Articles of Association (Aqd Al-Ta'sis) submitted on GAFI OSS Form LLC-01, leading to issuance of the Certificate of Incorporation and Commercial Register Extract
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: The limited liability company must have a subscribed capital divided into equal quota shares. The founders must fully subscribe the capital stated in the Articles of Association and deposit the entire subscribed amount in a corporate escrow bank account before registration. No universal fixed minimum is imposed for LLCs under Investment Law 72/2017, but the capital must be sufficient to cover the planned sewage treatment EPC works and must be released only upon GAFI approval.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: Resolution No. 1 of the Board of Directors of [Company] LLC. Resolved unanimously that the founders' subscription of [number] quota shares, representing fully paid initial capital, is hereby ratified and recorded. Resolved that the principal registered office be and is hereby established at [address], Cairo Governorate, Egypt, and that the legal address for service of process is as registered. Resolved that [Name] be and is hereby appointed Chief Executive Officer, [Name] Chief Financial Officer, and [Name] Company Secretary, each with authority to sign, file, and represent the company. Resolved that the Board execute all formation filings and banking appointments as required.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Pre-Incorporation Name Reservation and Activity Classification
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GAFI Investor Services Center / GAFI Online Name Reservation System
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a request to reserve the proposed Arabic and transliterated Latin company name through the GAFI name reservation portal. Specify the activity as design, construction, and commissioning of municipal sewage and reverse osmosis water treatment works under ISIC 4220 and NAICS 237110. Pay the nominal reservation fee and obtain the official name clearance certificate.
required_dossiers: Copies of national identity documents or passports of all founding members
Three proposed company names in Arabic with English transliteration
Power of attorney of the authorized incorporation agent
Detailed business activity description referencing ISIC 4220
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a name conflict is identified, file a restatement with alternative names online and request administrative review by GAFI's Legal Affairs Committee. The incorporation counsel may also file a written objection on grounds of distinguishing features, to be resolved within five business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Notarization of the Incorporation Contract and Quota Subscription
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cairo Notary Public – Corporate Notarization Department (Ministry of Justice)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the Arabic-language Memorandum and Articles of Association reflecting the scope, registered office address, capital distribution, and management structure. All members must sign the incorporation contract and initial quota subscription schedules before a licensed notary public. The notary will verify identity and certify the documents for submission to GAFI.
required_dossiers: Draft Memorandum and Articles of Association in Arabic
GAFI name clearance certificate
National identification documents or passports of all subscribers
Evidence of identification for directors and authorized signatories
Power of attorney if any member is represented
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary queries missing signatures or mismatched identity data, prepare supplemental signature pages, obtain certified translations for foreign nationals, and re-submit the notarial packet. GAFI can provide a one-stop notarization step where applicable.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Opening the Capital Escrow Account and Deposit Certification
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: A licensed Egyptian commercial bank acting as corporate escrow depository under Central Bank of Egypt supervision
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a provisional bank account in the exact intended corporate name using the notarized incorporation contract. Deposit the full subscribed capital or, where the capital is in-kind, provide a certified valuation report. Obtain an official bank certificate evidencing the capital deposit and specifying the account holder and amounts held for issuance to GAFI.
required_dossiers: Notarized Memorandum and Articles of Association
GAFI name clearance certificate
National IDs or passports of members
Capital subscription schedule
Independent valuation report for in-kind contributions, if applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank detects discrepancies between the notarized capital schedule and submitted IDs, file a corrective amendment to the Articles before the notary and provide a clarified statement of beneficial owners. If the bank requires an enhanced due-diligence questionnaire, deliver the completed questionnaire supported by the shareholding chart.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: GAFI One-Stop-Shop Filing and Statutory Examination
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GAFI One-Stop-Shop (OSS) – Companies Registration and Commercial Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upload the notarized incorporation contract, bank capital deposit certificate, name clearance certificate, and completed OSS Form LLC-01 to the GAFI electronic platform. Pay the consolidated state fees. GAFI will perform the legal compliance review, issue the Certificate of Incorporation, and simultaneously open the Commercial Registry file.
required_dossiers: GAFI OSS Form LLC-01 duly signed
Notarized Memorandum and Articles of Association
Bank capital deposit certificate
Name clearance certificate
Power of attorney for the submitting officer
Commercial lease or title deed for the registered office
Good standing certificates for foreign corporate shareholders, if any
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If GAFI issues a query or temporary refusal, the authorized lawyer must file a written reply within the statutory response period, provide supplemental corporate charts or legal translations, and request reconsideration before the GAFI One-Stop-Shop Manager. Where the objection concerns statutory activity scope, submit a revised SC-approved liquidation of the scope aligning with ISIC 4220.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Commercial Registry Extraction, Tax Card and National ID Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GAFI Commercial Registry and the Egyptian Tax Authority – Taxpayer Registration Department
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After issuance of the Certificate of Incorporation, the GAFI OSS automatically triggers the Commercial Registry Extract and issuance of the company's Tax Identification Number, VAT file, and electronic invoice registration. The company must verify the recorded activity code and update the tax e-submission profile to reflect ISIC 4220. Where construction EPC contracts require it, obtain a withholding-tax file and a VAT certificate for contractors.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation
Commercial Registry Extract
Board resolution appointing the financial officer and tax representative
Registered office lease contract
Passport or national ID copies of directors
Business bank account details
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the tax authority assigns an incorrect activity code or delays issuance, file a written request with the ETA activity-classification unit and attach the GAFI Commercial Registry Extract and the project reference contracts. The tax card request may be escalated through the GAFI OSS liaison for resolution within ten business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Labor, Social Insurance, Civil Defense and Workplace Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Ministry of Manpower – Regional Labor Directorate; National Social Insurance Authority; Civil Defense – Fire Safety Department
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register the company as an employer in the Labor Information System immediately after the commercial register extraction. Submit social insurance forms for all employees and obtain work permits for foreign directors or specialists. Complete a preliminary fire safety inspection of the registered office and obtain the Civil Defense clearance certificate valid for governance and preliminary project bid submissions.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation and Commercial Registry Extract
Labor registration Form 1
Social insurance registration forms and quota allocation
Passports or national IDs of employees and directors
Lease contract and floor plan for the registered office
Civil Defense fire-safety questionnaire and equipment inspection protocol
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Labor Directorate identifies incomplete employee data, resubmit the digital roster after correcting national insurance numbers and contract samples. For Civil Defense objections, undertake the required fire-safety upgrades and schedule a re-inspection. Appeals are made to the Ministry of Manpower inspector and the Civil Defense Appeals Committee.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Industrial Development Authority (IDA) and Ministry of Housing, Utilities and Urban Communities — Water Utilities Licensing Sector, in coordination with the Egyptian Water Regulatory Agency
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Municipal Sewage Treatment Plant Construction and Operating License / Class A EPC Contractor License for Public Wastewater Treatment Works

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Egyptian Environmental Affairs Agency (EEAA) — Environmental Impact Assessment Department, Ministry of Environment
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category 'B' or 'C' — Full Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA) required under Law 4/1994, as amended by Law 9/2009; a comprehensive EIA report including scoping, baseline characterization, impact assessment, mitigation, and public consultation is mandated for municipal sewage treatment plants above the initial intake threshold.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Compliance with Law 48/1982 for Nile and waterway protection, Ministerial Decree 92/2013 on treated wastewater reuse, and the EEAA Air Quality Regulation 338/1995. Effluent limits for BOD, COD, TSS, TN, TP, and residual chlorine must meet the specified water-course category; fugitive VOC and odour emissions require continuous monitoring and odor-control measures where population exposure exists. Sludge handling must conform to the Safe Reuse Guidelines and waste transport notification procedures.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification issued by the Civil Defense Authority under Law 377/1956 and gazetted executive regulations; structural-load inspection certificate for lifting stations, tanks, and treatment units; occupational health and safety clearance under Labour Law 12/2003, including confined-space entry protocols, chemical hazard inventory, personal protective equipment, and emergency-response signage.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) under the Ministry of Finance; unified online portal at www.eta.gov.eg and e-invoicing/e-receipt digital platforms
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign legal entity must register for a Tax Identification Number (TIN) at the Egyptian Tax Authority. For VAT purposes, the entity completes VAT registration through the ETA online portal after obtaining an economic activity certificate, notarized constitutional documents and power of attorney; non-resident entities can register directly or through a tax representative, and the TIN is issued within approximately 5-10 business days.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box pass-through election exists; corporations are taxed at entity level. Availability of limited statutory elections: choosing instalment payment of corporate tax, consolidating related entities under joint filing, and optional VAT registration below the threshold for exporters. Hybrid mismatch elections are not recognised in domestic law.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: EGP 500,000 annual taxable turnover of goods and services sold in Egypt; registration is compulsory within 30 days of crossing the threshold
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory e-invoicing for all B2B sales by VAT-registered taxpayers pursuant to ETA Law No. 67 of 2016. Invoices must be electronically signed, submitted in real time to the ETA E-Invoice platform via API integration, and validated by automatic fiscal clearance before issuance to the buyer; QR code stamping and XML/JSON structure are mandatory.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero rating applies to (i) direct export of goods with physical departure from Egypt, (ii) services supplied to non-resident recipients, wholly performed outside Egypt and used abroad, and (iii) international transport and related services. Claim requires verifiable export proof, customs exit records, and foreign currency proceeds credited into an Egyptian bank account.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (ACD/ECS) showing HS code, quantity, FOB value and port of exit
Original Bill of Lading / air waybill with Egyptian port of loading and foreign destination
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank confirmation of foreign currency proceeds received
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: False zero-rating and VAT refund claims are audited by the Central Administration for VAT Refunds. A claim can be retrospectively clawed back with interest at the statutory rate, plus administrative penalties of up to 30% of tax due; intentional fraud or forged export documentation triggers criminal penalties including imprisonment under the VAT Law and Income Tax Law.

stage_4.central_bank_authority: Full name of the Central Bank or Foreign Exchange Administration

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Renewal of Commercial Register Certificate
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Commercial Registry Bureau under the General Authority for Investment (GAFI)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Fixed statutory window: 1–31 January of each calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-renewal fine of EGP 500–2,000 (approx. USD 10–40); persistent non-renewal triggers administrative deactivation of the commercial record and inability to execute binding contracts or customs declarations.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) – Competent Tax Office
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: During January–February each year or within 30 days after expiry, whichever is later
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fixed fine of EGP 500 (approx. USD 10) plus freezing of tax clearance certificates required for banking, customs, tenders and government payments; repeated lapse may trigger forced re-registration and back-tax assessments.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Audited Annual Financial Statements with General Assembly Approval Minutes
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 6 months after fiscal year-end (by 30 June for a 31 December year-end); minutes must accompany the statutory filing
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fine of EGP 1,000–5,000 (approx. USD 20–100); persistent omission freezes the company file and blocks the January commercial-register renewal; the entity may be administratively strike-off after notice and opportunity to cure.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) – Head of Taxpayer File
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 4 months of fiscal year-end (by 30 April for calendar-year filers)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-payment penalty of 3% per month on unpaid tax (Law 26/2020); late-filing fine of EGP 1,000–5,000; understatement penalties up to 3x the avoided tax; persistent non-compliance can trigger enforced collection and banking restrictions.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Social Insurance Wage Declaration and Reconciliation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Monthly contribution returns due by the 15th of the following month, plus annual wage reconciliation declaration due each January
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Interest moratorium of 5% per annum on unpaid contributions plus EGP 100 per month per delayed declaration; undisclosed employees carry aggravated statutory penalties and personal liability of the manager.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Every Egyptian LLC must appoint at least one licensed auditor; LLCs with subscribed capital exceeding EGP 5,000,000 must appoint two licensed auditors. Independent statutory audit is mandatory for all companies regardless of turnover, and audited financial statements must accompany the GAFI annual filing and the ETA corporate income tax return.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Egyptian Accounting Standards (EAS) harmonized with IFRS; mandatory for financial statements submitted to ETA and GAFI. Construction/EPC revenue recognition follows EAS (IFRS 15 equivalent); segment and concession disclosures apply for the municipal sewage contract.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Egyptian AML rules (Law 80/2002, as amended by Law 194/2023) and GAFI practice require the company to maintain an accurate Ultimate Beneficial Owner (UBO) register and to reconfirm UBO data at each annual commercial-register renewal. Any share transfer during the year must be recorded in the Register of Members and perfected via GAFI's electronic portal; the updated register must be presented at renewal. False or incomplete UBO declarations carry fines of EGP 50,000–200,000 and the affected transfer is ineffective against third parties until registered.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Minute Book of General Assembly Resolutions
All statutory books, ledgers and supporting accounting records

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 400–1,200 depending on Cairo location and registered-agent/legal support scope
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 1,500–3,500 for a typical operating LLC; USD 5,000–8,000 if a Big-4 firm is required by financing covenants or public works contracts

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Flat 22.5% CIT for resident juridical persons under Law No. 91 of 2005 (Art. 8), reduced from 30% by Law No. 26 of 2020. Investment incentives under Law No. 72 of 2017: new infrastructure/water-treatment projects approved by GAFI may obtain a 5-year CIT exemption in Zone A/B governorates or a deduction of up to 50% of invested capital; environmental-asset accelerated depreciation is available under ETA schedules; dividend distribution tax remains a separate 10% final tax. The LLC must secure a GAFI investment certificate and ETA pre-approval before claiming any incentive.
